name: player_update_gun_and_turret_aim_nodes
description: Player::UpdateGunAndTurretAimNodes applies pitch to the gun-node Object3D matrix and yaw to the turret-node Object3D matrix from an aim direction vector.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly inspection in the current session verified the fastcall aimDirection/gunNode ABI with turretNode as the stack argument, null guards for all three inputs, horizontal length from the retail fast float-bit square-root estimate of x*x + z*z, gun-node pitch matrix fields, turret-node yaw matrix fields, and Object3D SetMatrix calls for both nodes.

The native smoke checks a nontrivial aim direction updates the gun and turret matrix rotation slots with the same fast square-root estimate and normalized yaw terms before exercising adjacent aim-basis and fire-point behavior.

Binary Ninja still carries a limited reconstruction marker because the original uses x87 arithmetic and the retail fast square-root bit estimate; no VC manifest covers 0x43a4f0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a player aim/source-cluster pass.
